_note: 閱讀（reading）島 sidecar：單一單元新引擎頁，補英語島覆蓋 gap。strand=reading。本檔含 1 個單元 eng.t_adv.reading.fact-vs-opinion（事實 vs 意見辨別，t_adv／學測），覆蓋知識點 eng.t_adv.reading.fact-vs-opinion。英語島治理：語感＞文法、英文學英文（R14＝teach 的 body 全英文零 CJK，中文對照放 zh_hint、預設收合），TOEIC 600-750 可讀的簡單英文，不教台式對比。閱讀子技能可客觀判定：practice 為 3 題 type:mcq、validation_method:expert，測三個不同角度的子技能（辨認事實句、辨認意見句、用『兩人可各持己見且都不算錯』判斷意見），各有唯一正解、綁 answer_evidence 指向本單元 claims、每個錯項附 distractor_rationales；選項長度相近、無長度/同類 cue（正解非唯一最短/最長）。宣告的知識點在某 teach 段與某 MCQ 的 kp_ids 皆出現（rubric⑦ 綁定成立）。事實／意見的判準與意見訊號詞皆以 Cambridge English 等權威查證、status:provisional、risk_class:normal、待英語母語 reviewer 複核。學習者端零年段字樣。無音檔（閱讀辨別、翻答案自評）。

units.title_zh: 分辨事實與意見（fact vs opinion）
units.can_do: 我能分辨一句話是『事實』（可以查證、證明真假）還是『意見』（某人的想法或感覺）；我會注意像 think、best、beautiful、should 這類意見訊號詞，也能用『兩個人可以各持己見而都不算錯』來判斷那是意見。
units.subject: eng

claims.text: A fact is a piece of information that can be checked and proven true or false. You can look it up, measure it, or count it, for example 'A week has seven days.'
claims.verification_ref: 事實是可以查證、量測或計數、能被證明為真或假的資訊，如『一週有七天』；屬閱讀通則；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: An opinion tells what a person thinks or feels about something. Two people can hold different opinions about the same thing and neither is wrong, for example 'I think summer is the best season.'
claims.verification_ref: 意見表達某人對某事的想法或感覺，同一件事兩人可各持不同意見而都不算錯，如『我認為夏天是最好的季節』；屬閱讀通則；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: Opinion words such as 'think', 'believe', 'best', 'worst', 'beautiful', 'boring', and 'should' are signals that a sentence gives an opinion rather than a fact.
claims.verification_ref: 意見訊號詞如 think／believe／best／worst／beautiful／boring／should，提示一句話給的是意見而非事實；屬閱讀通則；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: A fact is a piece of information that can be checked and proven true or false. You can look it up, measure it, or count it. For example, 'Taipei is in Taiwan' and 'A week has seven days' are facts, because anyone can check them and get the same answer.
teach.zh_hint: 事實是可以查證、證明真假的資訊。你可以去查、去量、或去數。例如『Taipei is in Taiwan』和『A week has seven days』都是事實，因為任何人去查都會得到一樣的答案。

teach.body: An opinion tells what a person thinks or feels about something. Two people can have different opinions about the same thing, and neither of them is wrong. Opinions often use signal words like think, believe, best, worst, beautiful, boring, and should. For example, 'I think math is fun' is an opinion.
teach.zh_hint: 意見表達一個人對某事的想法或感覺。同一件事，兩個人可以有不同的意見，而且誰都不算錯。意見常用訊號詞，例如 think、believe、best、worst、beautiful、boring、should。例如『I think math is fun』就是意見。

teach.body: Compare two sentences about the same film. Fact: 'The film is two hours long.' You can check the time, so everyone agrees. Opinion: 'The film is boring.' The word 'boring' tells how the writer feels, and another person may enjoy the same film.
teach.zh_hint: 比較關於同一部電影的兩句話。事實：『The film is two hours long.』時間可以查，所以大家都同意。意見：『The film is boring.』『boring』說的是作者的感覺，另一個人可能覺得同一部電影很好看。

teach.body: Your turn: write one fact and one opinion about your school. Make the fact something a reader can check, and make the opinion use a signal word like best or boring. Example answer: Fact — 'My school has a library.' Opinion — 'I think my school has the best library.'
teach.zh_hint: 換你做：寫一個關於你學校的事實，和一個意見。事實要讓讀者可以查證，意見要用像 best 或 boring 這種訊號詞。對照範例自評（不自動批改）：事實可查證、意見用了訊號詞即可（用字可不同）。範例：事實——『My school has a library.』意見——『I think my school has the best library.』

practice.stem: 下面哪一句是『事實』（可以查證、證明真假的句子）？
practice.answer: Our school library has three new computers.
options: Our school library has three new computers.
Our school library is the best place in town.
Reading very long books is quite boring.
Students should read one book every week.

distractor_rationales.Our school library is the best place in: 用了意見訊號詞 best，說的是感覺，不是可查證的事實。
用了意見訊號詞 boring，別人可能不覺得無聊，是意見不是事實。
distractor_rationales.Students should read one book every week: 用了意見訊號詞 should，說的是認為應該怎樣，是意見不是事實。

practice.feedback: 'Our school library has three computers.' 的數目可以去數、去查證，所以是事實。

practice.stem: 下面哪一句是『意見』（說出某人想法或感覺的句子）？
practice.answer: I think dogs make the best family pets.
options: I think dogs make the best family pets.
A dog has four legs and two ears.
Our class has twenty-five students now.
The sun rises in the east every morning.

這可以觀察、查證，大家會得到同一答案，是事實不是意見。
人數可以數、可以查證，是事實不是意見。
這是可以觀察證明的自然現象，是事實不是意見。

practice.feedback: 'I think dogs make the best family pets.' 用了意見訊號詞 think 和 best，說的是個人想法，所以是意見。

practice.stem: 兩個朋友可以對下面哪一句各持己見、而且誰都不算錯（因為那是意見）？
practice.answer: Pizza tastes much better than noodles.
options: Pizza tastes much better than noodles.
This box holds exactly ten books.
The corner shop closes at six o'clock.
A triangle always has three straight sides.

數量可以數、可以查證，大家會得到同一答案，是事實。
關門時間可以查證，大家會得到同一答案，是事實。
distractor_rationales.A triangle always has three straight sid: 這是可以證明的定義，大家都同意，是事實。

practice.feedback: 'Pizza tastes much better than noodles.' 是口味的感覺，不同人可以有不同看法而都不算錯，所以是意見。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案／說明自己判斷（閱讀辨別，不自動批改）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 朗讀檢查（不產音檔、不自動判讀）：把這三句出聲讀一遍，一邊讀一邊說出每一句是『事實』還是『意見』，並指出意見句裡的訊號詞。

lines.text: I think summer is the best season.
The film is two hours long.
